theorems.name: Submission.pcoarea_c1_injOn_area_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (k N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn k)) (χ : Rn k → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ V → InjOn χ V → ∀ S ⊆ V, MeasurableSet S → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → ∫⁻ x in χ '' S, φ x ∂μHE[k] = ∫⁻ z in S, φ (χ z) * ENNReal.ofReal ((fderiv ℝ χ z).toLinearMap.normDet)
